# Capacity Planning Template — Companion

- `capacity-plan-template.md` — fill-in capacity plan: baseline tables, growth projections, bottleneck analysis, quarterly scaling plan with costs, review schedule.
- `launch-capacity-runbook.md` — worked scenario: preparing an e-commerce platform for a 3x product-launch burst (baseline collection, projection math, mitigation plan, k6/locust load-test gates, rollback triggers).

Source: https://stackpractices.com/docs/capacity-planning-template/

The numbers are worked examples — replace them with your own metrics before using the plan.
